items.t: Novartis: Strong Kesimpta Sales, Higher Guidance, And More Upside
items.sum: The bull case for Novartis AG: Q3 Kesimpta sales rose 21.4% year over year, and 2026 core operating income guidance is flat to low-single-digit growth.

items.t: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) Posted Positive Phase III ORION 4 Results In ASCVD
items.sum: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) reported positive topline Phase III ORION-4 results for Leqvio in patients with established ASCVD. The trial, a large cardiovascular outcomes study, found Leqvio reduced major adverse cardiovascular events in secondary prevention patients.
